explanation: For the upper hemisphere g=√(1-x²-y²), the outward vector area element is ⟨-g_x,-g_y,1⟩ dA. Dotting with F=⟨1,x,0⟩ gives (x+xy)/√(1-x²-y²). The bottom disk contributes zero because F has zero vertical component. Thus d directly gives the combined integrand. All displayed choices also integrate to zero by symmetry, but d follows directly from the surface calculation.
